checks.full_source_review: Read all seven complete original items, author notes, 21 original starters and seven historical source items. Read the full final proposal and final starters, including the final shorter inwerken prompt. Checked all criterion translations, models, samples and quotes.
checks.count_and_ids: Exact seven historical IDs retained in order; three kort, four middellang; werk 4, educatie 2, overig 1.
checks.batch_check: npm run batch:check -- content/batches/046-proposed.json: Checked 7 items, 0 questions. No failures, no warnings. All seven existing catalogue IDs are intentional replacements.
checks.metadata: nt2-i, b1-spreken, draft, targetLevelValidated false; no retired type, revision or generated media. No B1 textType required for speaking.
checks.prompt_criteria: All requested counts and speech acts match. Cursusgemist now explicitly requests a day and time; inwerken now names both advice subjects. The brief reports in short tasks supply context for linked requests, within 20 seconds.
checks.sample_quotes: Fourteen non-null quotes match exact sample substrings. Each sample omits exactly one goal. One deliberate typical learner error per sample retained. All 21 model evidence quotes verified exactly.
checks.tables: Route: 25 minus 15 equals 10 minutes; no cars and one quiet crossing are separate reasons. Plan B retains four of eight parking places and adds three trees. Inwerken table gives distinct inconsistent-guidance and undocumented-procedure problems. Cursuslocatie: lesson ends 21:00; waits are 60 and 15 minutes; 20 seats fit 16 cursists and room B is available. No inferred bus journey duration is needed.
checks.cue_audio: Three natural single-interlocutor cues; m-young for medecursist, f-adult for colleague and manager, all approved Netherlands Dutch roles distinct from narrator. No digit readings or punctuation-dependent meaning. No multi-character conversation requiring a second character voice.
checks.media: Four native text tables supply the relevant stimuli; no picture generation needed. Generate seven narrator prompts and three cues after adoption. Audio and playback have not been reviewed.
checks.level_timing: Short models 32–34 words in 20 seconds; middellange 47–52 words in 30 seconds with 15 seconds preparation. Counts allow pauses at about 96–104 words per minute. All model sentences under 20 words. Means below the general 12–18 stimulus guide suit these short spoken responses; linked reasons, conditional language and interpretation preserve the B1 authoring demand.
checks.starters: All 21 partial frames tested with grammatical completions in criterion order. Facts remain blank. Repaired missing action in cursusgemist and weak priority framing in werkdruk. The proposed starters hash identifies the exact bytes to adopt.
checks.sources: No named organisation, invented business, address, KNM or high-stakes factual claim. All times and capacities are scenario data. No external source lookup required for these fictional exercises.
checks.references: Read AGENTS.md, blueprint sections, review and author briefs, rubric, workflow, Spreken I research paragraph, voices/illustration config, batch 044 review schema and B1 speaking catalogue titles. content/exemplars does not exist; project tasks listed per item are uncalibrated editorial comparisons.

diversity: Seven authorised historical topics remain. Work tasks distinguish route advice, task redistribution, priority requests and training improvements. Two education items address missed content and classroom relocation; one retained neighbourhood task argues for a compromise. This replacement group is not a complete mock form.
author_doubts_decisions: Short response lengths fit the configured time without requiring fast speech.
Route reasons are independently supported by traffic and crossing columns.
Street-plan sample mentions parking but says nothing about trees, so its null quote is valid.
Cursuslocatie sample states enough chairs for sixteen; an exact numeric capacity is not required by the criterion, and the missing travel reason remains absent.
Inwerken sample gives two advice points but no later check.
Historical topics are preserved deliberately; no new organisation-name searches apply.
media_notes: Adopt and verify hashes before generating seven narrator instructions and three cues. Regenerate any legacy audio based on changed text. No media or integration performed during review.
limitations: AI editorial review only; B1 remains an unvalidated authoring target. No official exam equivalence or score claim.
Speaking-time fit is based on text length and editorial judgment; no learner timing pilot or audio review performed.
